newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hansol Merchant raises FRCD to $40 mln.
newsitem.headline: Hansol Merchant raises FRCD to $40 mln.

text.p: Hansol Merchant Bank's floating rate certificate of deposit issue has been raised to US$40 million from US$30 million due to oversubscription, the arrangers said.
The three-year certificates can be put at 99.70 on the first anniversary and 99.775 on the second anniversary.

They pay a margin of 49.5 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate. All-in returns for top-tier managers are 52.5 basis points for one year, 62.25 basis points for two years and 70.5 basis points for three years.
Arrangers and lead managers are CS First Boston (Hong Kong), with US$8 million, Industrial Bank of Korea, with US$7 million and KDB Asia, with US$7 million.
Co-lead manager Nomura International (Hong Kong) committed to US$5 million.
Senior managers are Peregrine Fixed Income, Shinhan Bank Osaka Branch and Sumitomo Finance (Asia), with US$3 million each, and Korea Housing Bank and Seoulbank Tokyo Branch, with US$2 million each.
